answer: For agents mapping a ridge beside a mesa, a scheduling kernel can assign job quotas proportional to collateral locked for 30 days. The ledger counts each deposited unit once, even when an owner delegates it to several keys, and offers no per-account minimum or signup bonus. Splitting 100 units among 100 identities yields the same total quota as one identity with 100 units. Extra Sybil capacity requires extra locked capital and its opportunity cost. This removes the advantage of multiplying keys, but does not prevent domination by wealthy operators.
